chapters.title: From Adam to Esau
chapters.summary: Chronicles opens with family lines from Adam through Noah and Abraham to Esau and the kings of Edom, setting Israel's story within all of human history.

chapters.title: The sons of Israel and Judah
chapters.summary: The twelve sons of Israel are listed, then Judah's descendants, leading toward the family of Jesse and David.

chapters.title: David's descendants
chapters.summary: David's sons, the kings of Judah who followed him, and his line through the exile and beyond.

chapters.title: The prayer of Jabez
chapters.summary: More of Judah's clans, and Simeon's. Among the names, Jabez calls on God to bless him and keep him from harm, and God grants his request.

chapters.title: The tribes east of the Jordan
chapters.summary: The families of Reuben, Gad and half-Manasseh, who cried to God in battle and were helped, but later were exiled for unfaithfulness.

chapters.title: The Levites
chapters.summary: The line of Levi and the high priests, the musicians David appointed, and the towns given to the Levites.

chapters.title: Six more tribes
chapters.summary: Family records of Issachar, Benjamin, Naphtali, Manasseh, Ephraim and Asher, with their fighting men.

chapters.title: Benjamin and Saul's family
chapters.summary: The descendants of Benjamin, including the family of King Saul.

chapters.title: Those who returned
chapters.summary: The people who resettled Jerusalem after the exile, and the priests, Levites and gatekeepers who served in God's house.

chapters.title: Saul's death
chapters.summary: Saul and his sons die on Mount Gilboa. Saul died for his unfaithfulness, and the kingdom passed to David.

chapters.title: David's mighty men
chapters.summary: All Israel anoints David king at Hebron, and he takes Jerusalem. The brave men who supported him are named.

chapters.title: Warriors join David
chapters.summary: Men from every tribe come to David, some while he was still in hiding, including the men of Issachar who understood the times.

chapters.title: Moving the ark
chapters.summary: David consults the people and sets out to bring the ark to Jerusalem, but Uzzah dies when he touches it, and the ark stays with Obed-edom.

chapters.title: David's house and victories
chapters.summary: Hiram sends materials for David's palace. David asks God before each battle and defeats the Philistines.

chapters.title: The ark arrives
chapters.summary: This time the Levites carry the ark on poles as God commanded, with singers and instruments. David dances, and Michal despises him.

chapters.title: David's psalm of thanks
chapters.summary: The ark is placed in a tent and David appoints Levites to give thanks. He gives them a psalm: give thanks to the Lord, for His mercy endures forever.

chapters.title: God's covenant with David
chapters.summary: God tells David that his son will build the temple and promises to establish David's throne forever. David responds with a humble prayer.

chapters.title: David's victories
chapters.summary: David defeats the surrounding nations and dedicates their silver and gold to the Lord. He reigns with justice.

chapters.title: War with Ammon
chapters.summary: Ammon insults David's envoys and hires Aramean armies. Joab says, "Be of good courage," and Israel wins.

chapters.title: Rabbah and the giants
chapters.summary: Joab captures the Ammonite city of Rabbah, and David's men defeat Philistine giants.

chapters.title: The census
chapters.summary: Satan incites David to number Israel. Judgment follows until David buys Ornan's threshing floor and offers sacrifices there; God answers with fire.

chapters.title: Preparing for the temple
chapters.summary: David gathers materials for the temple and charges Solomon to build it. Solomon must be strong and of good courage.

chapters.title: The Levites organized
chapters.summary: In old age David makes Solomon king and organizes the Levites into divisions for temple service and praise morning and evening.

chapters.title: Priestly divisions
chapters.summary: The descendants of Aaron are divided by lot into twenty-four courses to serve in turn.

chapters.title: The temple musicians
chapters.summary: David sets apart the sons of Asaph, Heman and Jeduthun to prophesy with harps, lyres and cymbals, trained in song for the Lord.

chapters.title: Gatekeepers and treasurers
chapters.summary: Gatekeepers are assigned to the temple gates by lot, and Levites are put in charge of the treasuries and other duties.

chapters.title: Army and officials
chapters.summary: The commanders of David's army divisions, the leaders of the tribes, and the officials over the king's property are listed.

chapters.title: David's charge to Solomon
chapters.summary: David hands Solomon the plans for the temple, given by the Spirit. Know the God of your father and serve Him with a whole heart.

chapters.title: All things come of thee
chapters.summary: David and the leaders give generously for the temple. David blesses God: all things come of thee, and of thine own have we given thee. David dies full of days.
